svg.title: Endpoint And Marker Runs
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 27 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: Endpoint and marker runs avoid URL, comment, and regex collisions.
端点和标记运行符避开 URL、注释和正则误伤。

g.text: Double-slash endpoint machinery is intentionally not default-migrated yet.
双斜线端点机制暂时不迁入默认路径。
